entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_kusa_07
entries.text: 在最重要的時候擊中要害！\n這已經超越幸運，該說是才能了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_kusa_08
entries.text: 絕對不想輸的心情！\n讓我抓住了要害！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_hono_01
entries.text: 我一直一～直在等待著這一刻！\n最棒的對戰……要開始囉！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_hono_02
entries.text: 最後是這孩子嗎……\n用盡全力好好一戰吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_hono_03
entries.text: 發光吧！閃耀吧！\n我最棒的寶物！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_07_hono_04
entries.text: 我和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一起選寶可夢時得到的魔幻假面喵！\n至今為止的成果全部發揮出來吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: 想不到最初教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的屬性相剋關係\n會讓我陷入危機！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_01
entries.text: 希望這是一場讓觀眾看得開心的\n酥酥麻麻對戰喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_02
entries.text: 什麼！我好像有點危險了！？\n各位！快為我加油打打氣～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_03
entries.text: 出來吧！耀眼的小燈泡～！\n讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳見識見識奇樹的潛力！！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_01_04
entries.text: 上吧！電擊警報！\n覺得酥麻酥麻的話，我先說聲抱歉喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是非常好的素材。\n我該施展什麼樣的魔法好呢？[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還真是頑強呢。\n得好～好卸妝才行喔。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_03
entries.text: 花潔夫人，幻妝時間到嘍！\n蛻變成全新的自己吧！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_01_04
entries.text: 莉普的魔法幻妝，\n一路滲透到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的毛孔最深處。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_01
entries.text: 雙打對戰我的style！\n輪番上陣超有style！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_02
entries.text: 新秀力量讓我沒有退路！\n但別忘記我可還沒有輸！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_04
entries.text: 顫弦蠑螈，灌注你的靈魂！\n觀眾一定會把手舉到空中！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_01
entries.text: 我已經阻止過[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳囉。\n待會兒就算慘敗我也不管。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳確實如同傳聞所說。\n但[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳只要踏錯一步，就會摔落深淵喔。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_03
entries.text: 勝負和雪山很相似。\n兩者都會在轉眼之間發生變化。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_01_04
entries.text: 永遠地與絕望為鄰……\n在顫抖中睡去吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: 所謂的藝術就是破壞與創造！\n好好地掙扎，別成為養分了！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: 這可有點看頭啊！\n一口氣直達作品完成的終點吧！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: 加上更細緻的雕琢吧！\n其名為《由謊言結出的真實》！！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_04
entries.text: 在藝術裡，速度有時就是命脈！\n要開始加快速度囉！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是對我有恩沒錯，\n但我可不會放水喔！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: 潮水就是會起起落落！\n我要以怒濤的氣勢急起直追了！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: 是時候來個大變身了！\n潮到出水的寶可夢！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_04
entries.text: 緊緊跟上男子漢海岱高超的招式操作，\n別被淹沒啦！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: 對蟲寶可夢輕忽大意的話，\n說不定會吃大虧喔～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳滿厲害的呢～\n接下來戰況會怎麼演變呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: 破蛹而出，成長得又強又大吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_04
entries.text: 閃閃發亮的蟲蟲裝飾！\n不甜的也好好品嚐吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: 這也算是飯後的消化。\n我就適度地和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰一場吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: 跟被上司訓斥相比，\n我還大可撐得住呢。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_04
entries.text: 社會人所擅長的招式！\n不介意我使出來吧？[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: 總算能夠對戰了～！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳三兩下就輸的話，我可不會原諒喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: 哪！哈！哈！不錯嘛！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然挺有意思的！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: 看我把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳收拾掉！\n奮起吧！土王！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_04
entries.text: 會稍～微有點搖晃，站穩啊！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_01
entries.text: 上吧！小大王！\n吼～的一聲踩扁對手～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: 波琵的最後一隻寶可夢\n一定會想辦法贏的！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: 小匠匠，來好好打扮一下吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_04
entries.text: 比較硬梆梆的一邊才會贏！\n所以這場對戰波琵會贏～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_01
entries.text: 這次我就用飛行屬性承蒙指教了。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的實力不斷地在攀升。\n這會是一場硬仗嗎……[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_03
entries.text: 雖然我的髮型會變得凌亂，\n就來改變風向吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_04
entries.text: 讓我展現前輩的威風吧。\n請稍加注意。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: 請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳拿出真本事迎戰。\n小生會全力應戰的。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: 距離及格只差臨門一腳囉！\n加油！加油啊！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: 將太晶寶石加諸其頂！\n雄偉之龍啊，聽命降臨！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_04
entries.text: 壓制一切的力量！\n預備……龍龍龍！！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: 請務必戰勝我，成為冠軍喔。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: 招式是要像這樣施放的。\n請領略最頂端的感受。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: 啊哈！啊哈哈哈哈！\n還不能鬆懈下來喔！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_04
entries.text: 果然不簡單。正確的判斷。\n請保持那樣繼續下去。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_05
entries.text: 怎麼回事？這種程度應該不會\n讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳亂了陣腳才對？[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_06
entries.text: 這一招可真痛。\n要博得滿堂彩應該不是問題吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_07
entries.text: 哦？真叫人遺憾……\n擊中要害了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_10
entries.text: 晶光花，要做指引訓練家的光。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_00_01
entries.text: 我想起了討厭的傢伙。\n……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可要負起責任喔！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_02
entries.text: 我在尋找調味料的旅途中\n遇見的寶可夢大集合！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_03
entries.text: 用太晶化來慶祝恢復活力！\n發光吧，獒教父！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_01
entries.text: 竟然來向天星隊挑釁。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的是不要命了耶。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_02
entries.text: 手感ＯＫ！\n我要引擎全開囉！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這個入侵者！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_03
entries.text: ＤＪ惡事的頻率！\n接收它然後徹底壞掉吧！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_04
entries.text: 我的演出現在才要開始\n提高ＢＰＭ！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_01
entries.text: 既然在下已經來了，\n不制裁無禮之徒便不罷休！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_02
entries.text: 在下還有只要受到一點皮肉傷\n就會中毒的招式。怕了吧。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_03
entries.text: 被在下的奇技一點一點地侵蝕吧！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_04
entries.text: 一日入毒，終身為毒！\n秋明這條命會奉陪到最後！！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_01
entries.text: 我會好好疼[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還是哭喪著臉回家去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_02
entries.text: 明白我們之間的實力差距了沒？\n要投降的話就趁現在喔？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_03
entries.text: 吃我狡猾的一招！\n為我可愛的強大實力昏厥吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_04
entries.text: 啥！？這很不對勁吧！\n為什麼是我被逼到絕境啊！！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_01
entries.text: 這裡是我們的地盤。\n我不會讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再搗亂下去！！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_02
entries.text: 挨揍的話就要揍回去！！\n站到最後屹立不搖的才是勝者！！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_04
entries.text: 我……是不會輸的。\n所以……借我力量。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_02
entries.text: 這是……\n被打倒的手下們的份。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_03
entries.text: 燃燒吧……\n燒到變成灰燼吧。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: 我就是天星隊的仙后！\n好了，為大作戰劃下句點吧！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: ……沒辦法了。\n請容我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 呵。堂堂仙后竟然屈居劣勢啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_hono_01
entries.text: 我就是天星隊的仙后！\n好了，為大作戰劃下句點吧！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_hono_02
entries.text: ……沒辦法了。\n請容我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_hono_03
entries.text: 呵。堂堂仙后竟然屈居劣勢啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_mizu_01
entries.text: 我就是天星隊的仙后！\n好了，為大作戰劃下句點吧！[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_mizu_02
entries.text: ……沒辦法了。\n請容我使用太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_mizu_03
entries.text: 呵。堂堂仙后竟然屈居劣勢啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_01
entries.text: 要一決勝負的話就不准隨便！\n這就是天星隊的隊規！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_02
entries.text: 像星星一樣太晶化！\n變身成自己想成為的樣子吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_03
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳強大的實力無可挑剔。\n難怪老大們會被打敗。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_04
entries.text: 在布布力量之下化為星塵吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_01
entries.text: 我不知道來者何人，\n但礙事者就該驅逐出去。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_02
entries.text: 這就是古代的力量。\n很了不起吧？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_04
entries.text: 這種狀況為預料範圍內。\n很遺憾地，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的勝算為零。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_05
entries.text: 有意思……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了解古代的寶可夢的弱點嗎？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_06
entries.text: 我的數據相當齊全。\n人類的頭腦有辦法對抗嗎？[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_A_01_08
entries.text: 一如計算地擊中要害。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還是趕快死心吧。[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_01
entries.text: 我不知道來者何人，\n但礙事者就該驅逐出去。[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_02
entries.text: 這就是未來的力量。\n很了不起吧？[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_04
entries.text: 這種狀況為預料範圍內。\n很遺憾地，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的勝算為零。[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_B_01_05

entries.text: 哇！有奇怪的電波在干擾！\n這樣就算用駭客技術也解除不了！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_03
entries.text: 太狡猾了……！\n大人怎麼會做這種事！！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_05a
entries.text: 成功變成對戰形態了！\n加油啊，故勒頓！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_05b
entries.text: 成功變成對戰形態了！\n加油啊，密勒頓！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_06
entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！好像很不妙耶！\n想，想辦法撐住啊……！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_07
entries.text: 漂亮！撐下來了！\n是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的話就做得到……一定做得到！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_professor_02_08
entries.text: 騙人的吧！還沒有打倒嗎？\n這樣下去會很不妙的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_01
entries.text: 認真的奇樹可是一等一的喔～！\n把眼睛睜得像小磁怪一樣，好好觀賞吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_02
entries.text: 我說[VAR 0x0100(0000)]啊，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就不能再給我一點面子嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_03
entries.text: 出來吧！耀眼的小燈泡～！\n勝利的發明，咻嗶嗶嗶～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_04
entries.text: 劈哩，啪啦，剪刀石頭布！\n害怕電的都靠過來～！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_01
entries.text: 是來試聽莉普的美麗秘訣\n高級課程的啊。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_02
entries.text: 這樣的發展嚇到我了呢。\n明天的肌膚可是會受影響的。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_03
entries.text: 花潔夫人，新陳代謝！\n蛻變成全新的你吧！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_04
entries.text: 首先要的是美麗！\n有了美麗後，力量就會隨之而生。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_01
entries.text: 新生rookie，相當cutie！\n讓我渾身顫抖吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_02
entries.text: 勝算一絲僅１inch。\n為[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳獻上我的pinch！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_03
entries.text: 有光的話就會有影。\n立刻幻化吧，好恨好恨呀。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_04
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的punchline遠遠不及我！\n點醒[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的誤解就在我！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_01
entries.text: 狀態還可以。\n要打敗[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳已經很足夠了。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_02
entries.text: 我不會交出冰冷的成績單。\n我會用零度的酷炫技玩弄[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_03
entries.text: 雪啊，結晶啊，\n堆積到我們的身上吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_04
entries.text: 用這個會奪走熱度的招式\n來讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的腦袋冷卻下來吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_02
entries.text: 就以植物的堅韌為主題吧！\n荊棘上的刺是不會輕易掉落的！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_03
entries.text: 就回應[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的期待吧！\n《由謊言結出的真實　part2》[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_01
entries.text: 細細品嚐素材本味。\n這才是真正的海岱！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_02
entries.text: 要背水一戰了嗎？嘎！哈！哈！\n這就是寶可夢對戰的精髓啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_03
entries.text: 好勝毛蟹，太晶化吧！\n別拘泥於形態，順勢流動吧！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_04
entries.text: 大口地吸飽氣喔！\n激流就要朝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳而去了！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_01
entries.text: 今天就來個苦味吧～！\n就算輸了也請不要哭喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_02
entries.text: 蟲屬性就是要有忍耐力！\n我們會朝勝利撲過去的～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_03
entries.text: 小熊熊～！\n展現你羽化後的樣子吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_04
entries.text: 我會用裝飾過的招式打敗[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！\n這樣的甜點怎麼樣呢～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也真辛苦呢。\n誰叫首席那麼有個性。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳滿強的呢。\n讓我跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳糾纏下去吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_03
entries.text: 我就毫不保留地秀出自己吧。\n還是老樣子，拜託啦。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_04
entries.text: 這招的威力怎麼樣？\n還請確認看看。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_01
entries.text: 我想和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳平起平坐，\n所以……我要貪心地上囉！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_02
entries.text: 我真正的實力……！\n一點不剩地通通接下吧！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_03
entries.text: 在激鬥校園大戰中\n發出最燦爛的光芒吧，獒教父！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_04
entries.text: 用鍛鍊有加的下顎大咬特咬！\n咬斷[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她的勝利之路！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_01
entries.text: 請帶著[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳自己的風格，\n將力量發揮到淋漓盡致喔～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_02
entries.text: 哇～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很厲害耶～！\n請問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在培育上有什麼訣竅嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_03
entries.text: 我現在將注入能量。\n也就是進行所謂的太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_04
entries.text: 改變一下出招的模式吧。\n結果會變得怎麼樣呢～？[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_01
entries.text: 堂堂正正地一決勝負吧！\n願[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳武運昌隆！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_02
entries.text: 很行嘛！轉學生！\n我突然湧起鬥志了！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_03
entries.text: 超越昨天的自己！\n向著明天，嘿呀！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_04
entries.text: 就是要用盡全力！\n得手的勝利才有意義！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_01
entries.text: 藉由[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和我兩個人的力量\n來引導大家吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_02
entries.text: 讓我們來一場稱得上壓軸的\n頂尖對決吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_03
entries.text: 如同帕底亞的未來一樣\n發光吧，晶光花。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_04
entries.text: 強大的實力自不在話下……\n另外還要擄獲人心，才算是冠軍喔。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_01
entries.text: 退到懸崖邊緣的我們\n可是發揮本領派喔！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_02
entries.text: 獒教父，太晶化吧！\n現在的你比誰都閃耀！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_03

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_01

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_02
entries.text: 超越明天的自己！\n向著夕陽，太晶化吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和寶可夢的歷史為何等之物，\n我就試驗看看吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_01

entries.text: 就是現在，太晶化吧！\n閃耀光芒，一口氣解決掉對手！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_08_mizu_03
entries.text: 我要拿出真本事了喔！\n做好覺悟了吧？我的勁敵！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_kusa_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳透過尋寶成長了很多呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_kusa_02
entries.text: 作為肩負起學院的人，\n我來照亮大家吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_kusa_03
entries.text: 接下來的這招很強喔。\n還請稍加忍耐。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_hono_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳透過尋寶成長了很多呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_hono_02
entries.text: 作為肩負起學院的人，\n我來照亮大家吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_hono_03
entries.text: 接下來的這招很強喔。\n還請稍加忍耐。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_mizu_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳透過尋寶成長了很多呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_mizu_02
entries.text: 作為肩負起學院的人，\n我來照亮大家吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_02_mizu_03
entries.text: 接下來的這招很強喔。\n還請稍加忍耐。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_01
entries.text: 決賽也要進入尾聲了！\n請劃下完美的句點是也！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_02
entries.text: 頂端才配得上龍！\n讓一切都染上你的顏色吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_03
entries.text: 龍屬性還要更龍！\n龍上加龍！！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳鑽研得更加透徹了呢。\n實屬帕底亞冠軍的榜樣。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_02
entries.text: 晶光花，要成為照亮頂點的光。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_03
entries.text: 首席冠軍的氣魄！！\n請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳超越過去吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_01_01
entries.text: 對戰開始精彩起來了！\n我要叫朋友一起來助威～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_01
entries.text: 那孩子搞不好真的很厲害呢！\n就是那個樣子！加油啊！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_02
entries.text: 喔喔～撐住了！\n激烈的攻防讓我的心臟快受不了啦！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_01
entries.text: 剛才那一招可真是了不得喲！\n俺都要變成[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她的粉絲囉！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_02
entries.text: 既然是那個孩子，\n我相信[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她接下來一定會做些什麼的！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_03
entries.text: 招式選得好啊！\n狠狠地洗ＭＣ卡蒙一把臉！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_05
entries.text: 萊姆和那位同學！\n我期待看到一場HIGH炸的對戰喔～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_06
entries.text: 萊姆的寶可夢被打倒了！？\n哎呀～我興奮起來了呢！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_07
entries.text: 牠挺住萊姆的攻擊了！\n加油！加油啊～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_08
entries.text: 一副若無其事的樣子直搗弱點！\n小[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]弟妹[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳超SWAG！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_09
entries.text: 竟然選擇現在太晶化嗎！\nTiming很不錯喔！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_10
entries.text: 這股vibes真來勁。把手舉到空中！\n萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_11
entries.text: 現在就讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她見識妳的answer！\n萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_12
entries.text: 效果絕佳！超犀利的！\n萊姆！萊姆！萊姆！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_13
entries.text: 幽靈太晶最強～！\n萊姆，妳真的在閃閃發光喔！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_01
entries.text: １天１場的限定表演！\n歡迎來到ＤＪ惡事的舞台。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_03
entries.text: 我要大肆使壞囉！\n畢竟放水就算不上特訓了嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_04
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然會來同台共演呢。\n我是不會把觀眾讓給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_01
entries.text: 在下日夜都在學校修行！\n請一睹在下的實力吧！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_03
entries.text: 在下的毒之真髓！\n親身領教領教吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_04
entries.text: 劇毒哪怕是一丁點也會構成威脅！\n現在就放下心來可還太早喔。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_01
entries.text: 這次贏的可會是我。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳儘管繼續裝從容吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_03
entries.text: 看我可愛狡猾的一招！\n一邊打滾一邊品嚐痛苦的滋味吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_04
entries.text: 啥～！？難道我要輸了嗎！？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的實力根本是作弊等級吧！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_03
entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是我的對手……\n我就要全心全力地打敗[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_04
entries.text: 身陷絕境時更要集中精神！\n我還是有勝算的！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也是個口味奇特的傢伙啊……\n沒事。當我沒說。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_04
entries.text: 我竟然火燒屁股了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然很厲害嘛。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_01
entries.text: 歡迎來到北上。\n先品嚐品嚐泥土的滋味吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_02
entries.text: 哼……哎喲？\n原來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還懂屬性相剋啊。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_03
entries.text: 呿～！搞什麼！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳只是走運罷了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_04
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳連屬性相剋都不懂？\n我看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是預習得不夠吧～[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_05
entries.text: 受到北上洗禮的感覺如何？\n我也是覺得良心挺過意不去的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_06
entries.text: 斯魔茶！\n用超級吸取教訓教訓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_07
entries.text: 斯魔茶！\n用暗影球教訓教訓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_01
entries.text: 哇～好像在做夢一樣……！\n能跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰……好開心！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_02
entries.text: 噫嘿嘿……\n弱點被打得真徹底。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_03
entries.text: 竟然會擊中那種地方！？\n運氣也是實力的一部分……嗚咕咕咕。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_04
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳、[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳該不會有放水？\n我不太喜歡……那樣。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_05
entries.text: 蜻蜻蜓，拼沖天！\n切……切開空氣唄！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_06
entries.text: 蜻蜻蜓，拼沖天！\n振……振翅放聲唄！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_01
entries.text: 這、這次我會好好打出\n漂亮的對戰……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_02
entries.text: 好強大的一擊！\n傷害竟然會這麼大！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_03
entries.text: 剛剛的攻擊讓我\n整個人都縮了一下。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_04
entries.text: 大尾立，上唄！\n使勁撞上去！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_05
entries.text: 蚊香君，上唄！\n用全身撞上去！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就被我的輕便和服打扮給迷住吧。\n我會趁機打倒[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_02
entries.text: 喂！面具的事[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳還在記仇啊！？\n別使出效果絕佳的招式了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_03
entries.text: 不過是被擊中要害而已，有什麼大不了？\n我一點都不著急的。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_04
entries.text: 我要把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打得落花流水，\n然後神清氣爽地去慶典玩！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_05
entries.text: 今天是個值得慶祝的日子，\n所以來點豪華的吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_06
entries.text: 今天是個值得慶祝的日子，\n所以來點豪華的吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_01
entries.text: 我、我想贏！\n所以……我要拼沖天！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_02
entries.text: 啊啊，我搞錯了！\n不對，不是這樣的……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_03
entries.text: 怎麼會這樣！？\n局勢要被掌控走了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_04
entries.text: 為什麼會這樣？\n為什麼……為什麼？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_05
entries.text: 裹蜜蟲，拼沖天！\n用糖漿炸翻天！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_03_06
entries.text: 裹蜜蟲，拼沖天！\n用糖漿炸翻天！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_midoriikenushi_01_01_01
entries.text: 這傢伙好像很強！\n有我在，算[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳走運。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_midoriikenushi_01_01_02
entries.text: 牠變弱了！\n一口氣解決吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_01
entries.text: 我覺得很抱歉，\n但是我不能退讓。[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_02
entries.text: 還有挽回的機會！\n拼沖天……拼沖天！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_04
entries.text: 剛才那招很有效唄？\n我能贏過[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……我要贏！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_05
entries.text: 太棒了！\n我要趁勢掌控局勢！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_06
entries.text: 我要不出錯，\n要好好……下指示！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_04_07
entries.text: 我要不出錯，\n要好好……下指示！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_02
entries.text: 時髦的圍巾看了就火大！\n我要讓你一屁股坐下坐到翻！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_03
entries.text: 最後一擊由我下手！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該懂得讓給我這個隊長吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_04
entries.text: 哼～原來那是弱點啊！\n分析得好，副隊長！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuinu_01_01_05
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳竟然還能擊中要害！\n但我是不會把隊長的寶座讓給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_02
entries.text: 要是打得牠氣～呼呼，\n牠的臉也會變得紅～通通的嗎？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_03
entries.text: 那個招式出得好！\n上啊！收拾掉牠吧～！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_04
entries.text: 呵呵呵，找～到弱點了！\n我要用這招一路打到贏。

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_05
entries.text: 呵呵呵，真有效！\n打中奇怪的地方了嗎～？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_02
entries.text: 雖說是對手，但長得挺漂亮的。\n不覺得和我有點像嗎？

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_03
entries.text: 喂！要攻擊造成牠\n很多傷害的人是我！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_04
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳挺厲害的嘛！\n不愧是我的跟班……我是說朋友！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_05
entries.text: 誰叫你欺負厄鬼椪，\n這下遭到報應了吧！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_02
entries.text: 很高興[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳拿出真本事，\n我也會使出全力的！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_03
entries.text: 就算運氣不眷顧我，\n我也會拼沖天的……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_04
entries.text: 我還沒輸！\n我再也……不想輸了！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_05
entries.text: 對手再強也要正面迎戰！\n就用能夠必中的這個招式！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_06
entries.text: 對手再強也要正面迎戰！\n用雙翅攻擊唄！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳懂得屬性相剋嘛！\n不愧是我看好的人！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_04
entries.text: 現在還捉不到的！\n再展現一點實力給牠看吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_05
entries.text: 牠好像終於用盡力氣了！\n要捉厄鬼椪就趁現在！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_06
entries.text: 牠把面具太晶化了！\n這才是厄鬼椪真正的力量！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_01
entries.text: 既然[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳讓我這麼早起床，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就得陪我好好玩玩。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳老是戳別人痛處！\n我看[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該朋友很少吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_03
entries.text: 要害在哪啊！\n絕對沒擊中的！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_04
entries.text: 就算你之後想跟我走，\n我也不會理你的！厄鬼椪！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_05
entries.text: 傻乎乎地看著吧！\n我要把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳刷、來、刷、去！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_06
entries.text: 傻乎乎地看著吧！\n我要把[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳刷、來、刷、去！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_01
entries.text: 給我一個夠讚的表情吧。\n我要擷下那個精彩瞬間。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_02
entries.text: 同學，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真有兩下子！\n我沒閒功夫拍照了。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_03
entries.text: 好痛痛痛……\n嚇得我相機差點都要掉了。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_04
entries.text: 這孩子的話如何呢？\n我想牠應該會有點難對付喔。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_05
entries.text: 要上囉，葉伊布！\n我要擷下那個精彩瞬間！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_06
entries.text: 要上囉，葉伊布！\n我要擷下那個精彩瞬間！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_02
entries.text: 哦，是按下快門的好機會！\n但我站不起來！可惡～！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_03
entries.text: 戰況漸入佳境！？\n拜託了，替我拍幾張照片吧～！！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_02
entries.text: 這臨場感，太棒了太棒了！！\n就這樣，繼續保持……！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_03
entries.text: 還能擺出不同的表情！？\n真讚，我都要拍得欲罷不能啦。[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_04
entries.text: 赫月變弱了！\n捕捉牠的機會來了，助手！[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_01
entries.text: 與[VAR 0x0100(0000)]一同冒險的回憶，\n化為了厄鬼椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_02
entries.text: 與大家一起奪回面具的回憶，\n化為了厄鬼椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_03
entries.text: 與曾經一起生活的男人之間的回憶，\n化為了厄鬼椪的力量！

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_01
entries.text: 作為藍莓學園的代表，\n可不能讓人看到我丟臉的一面呢。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_02
entries.text: 原來如此！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳會精確利用\n屬性相剋關係來進攻呀。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_03
entries.text: 被擊中痛處了。\n該怎麼重振旗鼓呢……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_04
entries.text: 正負電戰術行不通呢……\n那麼那麼，別怪我來硬的囉。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_05
entries.text: 龍頭地鼠！拜託你了～！\n盡情搖晃吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_01
entries.text: 機會難得，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就品嚐品嚐\n生態巨蛋的泥土的滋味吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_02
entries.text: 喂！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳偶爾也用個\n效果不好的招式嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_03
entries.text: 動～不動就攻擊這種地方！\n是要我教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳什麼叫體貼嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_04
entries.text: 是時候該認真使出那、個、了！\n呵呵呵……來點閃閃晶的吧～？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_05
entries.text: 上了吧！來悲粗茶！\n刷啊刷啊刷個夠吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_06
entries.text: 啊！這不是厄鬼椪嗎！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然真的很想我嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_01
entries.text: 那麼，料理……\n說錯了！對戰開始！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_02
entries.text: 呃啊～！？吃了那樣的招式\n火都要熄啦～！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_03
entries.text: 什麼？吃了一記好～大的傷害啊！？\n怎麼會這樣！？[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_04
entries.text: 燃起大火太晶化！\n變得火紅吧，火焰雞～！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_05
entries.text: 這就是我的特製佳餚！\n盡情享用赤松套餐吧！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_01
entries.text: 盔甲鳥、三地鼠，各就各位。\n準時結束這場對戰吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_02
entries.text: 確認到屬性不利……！\n被趁虛而入，讓納莉我的眼鏡起霧了。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_03
entries.text: 原來還有這樣的壞運氣。\n真是獲益良多，謝謝了。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_04
entries.text: ……時間迫在眉睫。\n是時候做了結了。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_05
entries.text: 體力越多，\n這招式就會越折磨[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_01
entries.text: 這次我會以四天王的身分，\n用我慣用的同行隊伍和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳對戰。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_02
entries.text: 雖說攻擊弱點是對戰的標準戰術……\n但我們也會以牙還牙的！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_03
entries.text: 被打中奇怪的地方了！\n我覺得那是不好的！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_04
entries.text: 請看這太晶之心！\n變得可～愛、可～愛、更～可愛吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_05
entries.text: 龍頭地鼠，上吧～！\n讓可愛的破壞力炸開吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_01
entries.text: 給我好～好地打贏喔？\n要是辜負了我的期待，我會哭的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_02
entries.text: 哦～！？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳竟然打出了效果絕佳！\n我們的弱點應該是很少的啊！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_03
entries.text: 啊～！真是欲罷不能！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳居然連運氣都捉住啦！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_04
entries.text: 沸騰吧，龍之血。\n主宰一切吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_05
entries.text: 看我徹徹底底地釋放！\n我是不會讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳逃走的喔？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_01
entries.text: 我沒有錯……\n現在就讓我來對答案吧！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_02
entries.text: 我精心鍛鍊的招式怎麼樣！\n和北上的時候不一樣吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_03
entries.text: 唔！哇咧老天哦……\n就算相剋關係不利我也不會輸！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_04
entries.text: 就連好運都在幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，真的很不公平……\n不公平！不公平！不公平！！不公平！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_05
entries.text: 我不需要過去的自己！\n所以我改變了……我要改變！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_06
entries.text: 趕快倒下行不行啊！\n我都已經拼盡全力了！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_07
entries.text: 我也想親自……\n把勝利捉進手中啊！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_01
entries.text: 上啊！太樂巴戈斯！\n讓[VAR 0x0100(0000)]見識你的力量！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_02
entries.text: 欸？牠竟然有弱點？\n牠明明是……零之秘寶啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_03
entries.text: 就連這個節骨眼都能擊中要害？\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的主角氣場也太強了唄……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_04
entries.text: 秘寶應該要很厲害才對唄！？\n快釋放你真正的力量啊！快！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_05
entries.text: 這就是零之秘寶真正的樣子！？\n這樣的話……我能贏……！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_06
entries.text: 太樂巴戈斯的力量應該不只如此……\n是有什麼條件不夠嗎……？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_02
entries.text: 能量失控了！？\n這樣下去很危險！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_03
entries.text: 抱歉了，大家！\n請你們阻止……太樂巴戈斯！！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01
entries.text: 喂！阿栗你也快做些什麼啊！\n得想辦法搞定太樂巴戈斯才行……！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_01
entries.text: 不、不該是這樣……不對……\n都是因為我……才變成這樣嗎……！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_02
entries.text: 是會減輕傷害的屏障嗎……！？\n那麼[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]太晶化[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]或許會有效！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_03
entries.text: 你們兩個，趁現在！\n用太晶化來反擊！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_04
entries.text: 來悲粗茶被打倒了……\n這是怎麼回事……牠也太強了吧！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_06
entries.text: 抱歉！我的寶可夢\n全都被打倒了！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07
entries.text: 又展開了那麼強大的屏障！？\n牠是吸收了能量去展開的嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07_01
entries.text: 阿栗！你也上啊！\n現在只有[VAR 0x0100(0000)]在拼命啊！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07_02
entries.text: 不、不行……！\n我才……不可能辦得到……！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_08
entries.text: 就是現在，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳又能用太晶化讓寶可夢閃耀了！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_01
entries.text: 牠又再度吸收了能量！？\n我不認為牠能一直反覆這樣，但……[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09
entries.text: 阿栗！[VAR 0x0100(0000)]陷入困境了！\n喂！我說你啊！你也要加把勁啊！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_02
entries.text: 可、可是……不行……\n我、我……我這種人……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_10_01
entries.text: 真是的……拜託！太慢了啦！\n你們倆給我想辦法搞定！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_11
entries.text: 看來牠已經無法吸收能量\n或再次展開屏障了！機會來了！[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_11_01
entries.text: 我批准了！\n你們倆動手吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_12
entries.text: 現在的話，牠說不定\n會進到球裡……！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_02
entries.text: 哇、哇咧老天哦！\n幹嘛突然攻擊別人啊……！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_03
entries.text: 抱歉，但我們也只能靠對戰\n讓他們冷靜下來了唄……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_02
entries.text: 爺爺！奶奶！怎麼連你們都！\n到……到底怎麼回事！？[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_03
entries.text: 怎麼會變成這樣……\n唔唔……只能拼了唄……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_02
entries.text: 麻吉麻吉～！！\n啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_03
entries.text: 吃了……很厲害的……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_04
entries.text: 不愧……打中了……痛……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_hono_05
entries.text: 還沒……完……對戰……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_kusa_02
entries.text: 麻吉麻吉～！！\n啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 吃了……很厲害的……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_kusa_04
entries.text: 不愧……打中了……痛……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_kusa_05
entries.text: 還沒……完……對戰……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_mizu_02
entries.text: 麻吉麻吉～！！\n啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_mizu_03
entries.text: 吃了……很厲害的……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_mizu_04
entries.text: 不愧……打中了……痛……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rival_02_01_mizu_05
entries.text: 還沒……完……對戰……\n麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉，麻吉麻吉～！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_botan_02_01_02
entries.text: 哇喔喔喔喔喔喔！！\n嚜吉！嘛吉咿～！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_botan_02_01_04
entries.text: 嗚嘎啊啊啊啊嘶！！\n嚜～吉！嘛啊嘰～！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_02
entries.text: 有、有效耶……也就是說，\n那傢伙是能打倒的！拼沖天！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_04
entries.text: 那傢伙的動作變慢啦！\n趁現在！把牠關進球裡！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_01
entries.text: 觀眾數就像麻麻鰻魚王逆流而上！\n顆呵呵！真叫人欲罷不能呢～[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_02
entries.text: 出來吧！耀眼的小燈泡～！\n浮在空中的電是無～敵的喔！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_03
entries.text: 劈哩，啪啦，剪刀石頭布！\n麻麻的好開心，男生女生配！[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_01
entries.text: 正因為被逼入逆境，\n莉普我才能變得更美麗。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_02
entries.text: 超能魔法展現的幻妝！\n不許看別處，１秒都不行！[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_03
entries.text: 哎呀？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的骨盆是不是歪了？\n我來用精神強念幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳矯一矯吧。[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_01
entries.text: 重重攻擊大難在即！\n巧妙反擊讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳圓寂！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_02
entries.text: 顫弦蠑螈！心煩意亂！\n奏響和弦！擊退冷汗！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_03
entries.text: 大病初癒很不行？\n禍不單行如酷刑！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_01
entries.text: 輕易輸掉是會冷場的。\n我稍微……再掙扎一下吧。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_02
entries.text: 雪靜靜地堆積，\n如同覆蓋弱點般。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_03
entries.text: 我要使出冰冷的招式了。\n就算[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳被凍住了也不關我的事。[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: 好啊，真是前衛！\n保持這股勁，持續創造吧！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: 能成為長青的話題才稱得上是名作！\n《由謊言結出的真實　forever》！！[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: 要加快速度囉！\n閣下理當是跟得上吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: 對戰如水！哇、哈、哈！\n就是變化莫測，才對味啊！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: 是時候來個大變身了\n新鮮活跳跳！潮得水潤潤～！[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: 集水即能成槌！\n要見識看看它的威力嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: 蟲屬性就是韌性特強～！\n看我從腳下讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳栽個大筋斗～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: 小熊熊，裝飾吧！\n戴上觸角扮蟲蟲～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: 不快點阻止這個招式，\n可是會出大事的喔～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: 如果是在工作時間內，\n那我會對應到最後的。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: 普通就很好。\n用一般的來進行吧。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_03
entries.text: 社會人所擅長的招式！\n……這說出來真叫人心酸啊。[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_01
entries.text: 就算佔下風我也是游刃有餘！\n因為我最重要的搭檔還沒上場呢！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_02
entries.text: 獒教父，你懂的吧！\n你要變得比誰都閃耀！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_03
entries.text: 用結實的臼齒狠狠咬碎！\n每天刷牙可不是白刷的！[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_01
entries.text: 哎呀～糟糕。\n不派出最後的布布不行了～[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_02
entries.text: 天星啊綻放光輝，太晶化！\n一定能變身成自己想成為的樣子！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_03
entries.text: 灑落吧星光！\n在布布力量之下大鬧一番！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_01
entries.text: 展現不到最後絕不放棄的心！\n卯足氣勢，嘿呀！嘿呀！！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_02
entries.text: 將緊握的拳頭轉成力量！\n熱血沸騰地太晶化吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_03
entries.text: 進攻吧！朝著身體！重擊！\n捨棄防守，只管進攻！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_01
entries.text: 不歸零就不算輸。\n那我就石石在在地火力全開吧？[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_02
entries.text: 岩石屬性和岩石太晶相乘，\n稜角會變成幾倍呢？[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_03
entries.text: 鹽石巨靈，我們上吧。\n使出銳角的尖石攻擊！[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_01
entries.text: 歷史就是由連續不斷的背叛而成。\n順遂之時更不可驕傲自滿。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_02
entries.text: 雖然最新技術不合我的性情，\n但科技啊，啟動吧！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_03
entries.text: 淋淋這怨念吧。\n要是能降低特防，我就賺到了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_01
entries.text: 討～厭，快輸了！\n超級不敢相信的～！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_02
entries.text: 很棒喔，超壞星！\n你表演的時候到了。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_03
entries.text: 用不得了的一招給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好看！\n俗話說是藥三分毒，聽過吧！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_01
entries.text: 賭上這身肌肉頑強抵抗！\n薩瓦羅啊，咬緊牙關撐住。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_02
entries.text: 論可愛也不會輸。\n布莉姆溫，請太晶化。[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_03
entries.text: 想不想被吸取精力的接吻\n迷得神魂顛倒啊？[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然厲害～我好高興啊～\n雖然我已經沒有退路了～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_02
entries.text: 輸出確認完畢！\n啟動太晶珠～[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_03
entries.text: 奇麒麟，要上囉～！\n用念動用力發動攻擊～！[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_01
entries.text: 賽吉我一個頭兩個大～！\n寶可夢！居然！Only１隻！[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_02
entries.text: 讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳瞄一眼\n賽吉有點厲害的一面！[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rival_01_kusa_01
entries.text: 雖然覺得不甘心，但真是愉快！\n接下來才是最有看頭的喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rival_01_kusa_02
entries.text: 發光吧！閃耀吧！\n我們最棒的寶物！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rival_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 我的全部！\n不管幾次[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳都要接好喔！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: 看到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳變得這麼強……\n我可不能就此敗落呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: 校長我也要拿出真本事了。\n看我用太晶化綻放光芒吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: 那麼，骨紋巨聲鱷，\n就使出暗影球如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_mizu_01
entries.text: 看到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳變得這麼強……\n我可不能就此敗落呢。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_mizu_03
entries.text: 那麼，魔幻假面喵，\n使出千變萬花如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_hono_03
entries.text: 那麼，狂歡浪舞鴨，\n使出劈瓦如何？[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: 凡事的關鍵都在如何收尾。\n看小生如何畫龍點睛吧。[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: 是時候戴上龍之寶冠了。\n讓一切都染上你的顏色吧！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: 請容我們以背相對是也！\n戟脊龍，巨劍突擊！[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: 啊哈！啊哈哈哈哈！\n我還不會被將死的喔！[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: 仆斬將軍，\n願那照亮頂點的光常在。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: 光芒啊，從萬丈高處\n席捲一切吧。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳果然厲害喲～\n我使出全力也打不壞[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳。[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: 我就再疼～愛[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一下吧。\n隆起吧！土王！[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳今天可要做好覺悟喲？\n因為我會一搖再搖，讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳搖～個不停。[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_01
entries.text: 波琵我還沒輸喔！\n我一定會搬回城堡的～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: 小匠匠，來好好打扮一下，\n打扮得硬梆梆吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: 波琵我要來硬硬的喔。\n請吃下這招吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_01
entries.text: 手上的寶可夢還剩……呃！\n下一隻是最後的寶可夢了！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_02
entries.text: 一把火燃燒太晶化！\n用熱氣把對手蒸熟吧，火焰雞～！！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_03
entries.text: 盡情享用辣～辣的招式吧！\n還有敗戰的鹹味在等著[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_01
entries.text: 情勢不利……但是，\n納莉我的鬥志絕不挫敗。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_03
entries.text: 開始加壓。\n要恨就恨自己的體力吧。[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_01
entries.text: 被占上風也沒問題！\n我會硬是頂住，直到獲勝！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_02
entries.text: 太晶之心大放送～～！\n讓我分[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一些可愛吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_03
entries.text: 龍頭地鼠，上吧～！\n用可愛的招式迷倒對手！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_01
entries.text: 真叫人全身是勁啊，死黨！\n果然對戰就是要這麼刺激！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_02
entries.text: 沸騰吧，龍之血。\n告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她誰是主宰者～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_03
entries.text: 看我驚天動地釋放！\n在這麼沸騰時，我是不會放[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳走的喔？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_01
entries.text: 動～不動就把人逼得走投無路！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也只有現在能裝從容了！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_02
entries.text: 休想一個人出鋒頭！\n我也是能閃閃晶的！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_03
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想被刷來刷去是吧？\n呵呵呵，不用跟我客氣！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_01
entries.text: 好苦……但好開心！\n我要從這裡重新開始！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_02
entries.text: 那份永不改變的心情！\n現在！全部注入太晶裡！！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_03
entries.text: 我要盡全力拼沖天！\n蜜集大蛇你也要跟進哦！[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很有一套嘛～\n好像越來越有趣了！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_02
entries.text: 既然有這麼多觀眾在看，\n那就來點有趣的吧！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_03
entries.text: 這招如何呢～？\n可要好好地撐下來喔。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.text: 那能量是怎麼回事！？\n難道……那就是……！？[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
